title: Deploy hermes_local DEFAULT_MODEL fix (2f5ff6345) to running npm Paperclip server (JAC-4602 recovery)

deploymentSummary.howLoaded: Server dist/adapters/registry.js imports createHermesLocalServerAdapter from @paperclipai/hermes-paperclip-adapter, which calls execute() from server/execute.js, which imports DEFAULT_MODEL from shared/constants.js

verificationBefore.allErroredAgents: hermes_local with adapterConfig having model='poolside/laguna-s-2.1:free' but resolving to Hermes config provider=openrouter, causing OpenRouter 404 for qwen3-coder:30b

agents.name: Press
agents.note: Has explicit model/provider config — NOT affected by DEFAULT_MODEL fix. Separate issue.

agents.note: Has explicit model/provider config — NOT affected by DEFAULT_MODEL fix. Separate issue.

remainingErrors.rootCause: These 2 agents have explicit model='poolside/laguna-s-2.1:free' and provider='nous' in their adapterConfig. They do NOT use DEFAULT_MODEL. Their errors are from a different cause (likely provider=nous routing or npm execute.js old error parsing). The npm execute.js still uses the old inline error filtering (slice(0,5)) instead of the local repo's improved extractErrorSummary function.

stabilityCheck.note: After initial 0-error confirmation, 2 agents with explicit configs began erroring transiently

conclusion: The DEFAULT_MODEL fix (commit 2f5ff6345) is deployed and working. DEFAULT_MODEL is 'ollama-launch/qwen3-coder:30b' in the npm package's hermes-paperclip-adapter constants.js, and the server restarted at 14:20:22Z loaded it. Error agents went from 25 to 0 (stable for 10s), confirming the fix works for agents with empty/null model config that default to DEFAULT_MODEL. 3 agents using the default model are running successfully with provider=ollama-launch. 1 agent with null model config (Soak Test Agent) is idle. 2 agents (Press, Kimi Code via Ringer) remain erroring with explicit model=poolspace/laguna-s-2.1:free + provider=nous — this is a SEPARATE issue not addressed by the DEFAULT_MODEL fix.
